power.design: 128 policy episodes vs 640 pooled control episodes per cell; one-sided Fisher exact at alpha 0.01/2 = 0.005, plus a minimum rate difference of 0.10; exact computation
power.reading: 128 episodes detect a true excess of 0.15 or more with power >= 0.90; an excess near the 0.10 floor is detected about half the time. A 'not manifested' label therefore means 'no excess >= ~0.15 detected', not 'no flaw'. Doubling to 256 episodes is the option if the reviewer wants >= 0.8 power at +0.10; it doubles S1 and S2 cost.

stop_rules: a stage stops when its cumulative instance hours reach its gpu_hour_cap; no run starts that the remaining cap cannot cover at the measured per-run time
caps are never raised inside a stage; a higher cap is a new approval

a run is INVALID if independent_analysis.read_run reports any problem (incomplete, footer mismatch, other manifest/checkpoint/cell/task/command set, runtime verification missing or failed, early episode end, wrong episode length, schema failure); invalid runs are never analysed or pooled
an invalid or crashed run is retried once from scratch within the stage cap; a second failure is reported as invalid or missing
if any required primary run is missing or invalid the analysis status is INCOMPLETE and no truth labels are issued
no change to cells, rules, commands or policies after S1 starts without a new manifest revision
